title: Rav Chananel bar Papa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Shabbat 88b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.88b.3): He said, “What does the verse ‘[Hear, for I will speak of princely things](https://www.sefaria.org/Proverbs.8.6)’ mean? Why are the words of Torah likened to a prince? To tell you that, just as a prince has the power to put to death and to give life, so too the words of Torah,” etc. Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim reads Rabbi Chanana bar Papa.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1551&lang=en) give Rav Chananel bar Pappa. Chanana is Hyman’s report of the Dikdukei Soferim reading.
